meta.title: Photo & Map Credits
meta.description: Photographers, licences and map data sources used on the Wildora Expeditions website.

head.title: Photo & map credits
head.lede: We only use images and map data we have the right to use. Here is where each one comes from.

wildlife.heading: Wildlife and habitat photographs
wildlife.body: Photographs of species and habitats across the site were supplied by the Wildora team, except those credited below. Please do not reuse the team's photographs without permission.
wildlife.commons: These are from Wikimedia Commons under open licences. Edited versions are shared under the same licence as the original.

landscape.heading: Landscape photographs
landscape.body: Landscape photographs in the itineraries on the <link>trip pages</link> and at the top of the About page, from Wikimedia Commons under open licences. Edited versions are shared under the same licence as the original.

maps.heading: Maps
maps.body: Maps are drawn from <naturalEarth>Natural Earth</naturalEarth> data, which is in the public domain. India's boundaries follow Natural Earth's India point-of-view dataset. Route lines and stop positions are approximate and for orientation only. Links to individual places open in <osm>OpenStreetMap</osm> (© OpenStreetMap contributors).

typefaces.heading: Typefaces
typefaces.body: Hanken Grotesk, under the SIL Open Font License.

wrongCredit: Think something here is yours and credited wrongly? <link>Tell us</link> and we will fix or remove it.
